constraints: Cost: image generation is not in the cost ledger (image_gen_stream emits zero tokens and no usage event, and cost-core has no image pricing), so an agent tool must add per-image pricing and budget checks before agents can loop on it. ZDR: generate_image is refused on ZDR turns (zdr_features.rs:129, inference-core grpc.rs:674), so the claim that C2PA signing works under ZDR is moot until generation itself is allowed there; the agent tool must carry the same refusal and a capability gate. Plane ownership: inference-core owns provider adapters and image models, model-gateway owns the stream and artifact events, and no durable binary artifact writer exists in Model Plane, so edit lineage needs either the Data Plane file or document store through its API (no cross-plane DB access) or client-resent base images via F-t3-017. The signing certificate belongs in Control Plane secrets and signing must occur where bytes are produced. The Gemini adapter depends on F-t3-041 (absent). The ChatGPT-subscription route disables image generation in the composer.
approachAdjustment: Correct the gap text: revised_prompt is already surfaced as the artifact title (sse.rs:6006-6009), and a prompt length check and n cap exist in inference-core, so the real gaps are no semantic screen, no cost or concurrency accounting and no agent-callable path. Sequence: (1) S-M generate_image tool in the chat tool_loop and the Do loop with a typed result and per-run semaphore, priced through cost-core and gated by ZDR and capability policy; (2) provider-neutral selection that fails or asks instead of silently falling back, surfacing model_used; (3) decide the durable home for binary artifacts before building edit or mask; (4) C2PA signing at the point bytes are produced (image_gen_stream and the tool path) with the c2pa crate; (5) mark tool and edit endpoint; (6) Gemini adapter behind F-t3-041.
